subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw support raw `[[...]]` button JSON in model final text as a fallback for Gemini, or require models/providers to use typed message-tool presentation buttons only?
rationale: Current source proves the gap, but the proposed parser would create a new model-output fallback syntax that crosses prompt, final-reply, transcript, and Telegram presentation boundaries.

options.title: Accept a narrow raw fallback
options.body: Allow a constrained raw-button parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

options.title: Retarget to typed routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the issue focused on provider/tool prompting so Gemini uses `message(action=send)` with structured buttons.

options.title: Defer until live repro
options.body: Leave the issue open but do not accept implementation work until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini/Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept a narrow raw fallback
recommendation.body: Allow a constrained raw-button parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses the typed presentation contract and Telegram button rendering paths where recent mainline history points most strongly.
